sources.title: Bitcoin address balance and transaction history — Binance-designated SAFU wallet
claims: The page displays a balance of 15,000.00147092 BTC for the Binance-designated SAFU address.
The page reports 27 transactions, total received 31,277.00056174 BTC and total sent 16,276.99909082 BTC; latest transaction shown is 2026-08-09.
limitations: The page does not expose a precise block-height or data-refresh timestamp in the captured result.
The transaction count differs from BitInfoCharts' 28; net received-minus-sent and displayed balance agree to displayed precision.

sources.title: Bitcoin address transaction history — Binance-designated SAFU wallet
claims: The page lists 27 transactions for the Binance-designated SAFU BTC address and shows the latest transaction dated 2026-08-09.
The displayed balance is consistent with approximately 15,000.00147092 BTC.
limitations: The page's data-refresh timestamp and exact current block height were not available in the captured result.
The latest transaction date is not proof that no unconfirmed or separately held SAFU assets exist.

independence_policy: Tokenview, SoChain and BitInfoCharts are separate public explorer providers. They corroborate the displayed address balance and latest transaction date, but the differing transaction counts and absent block-height timestamps remain data-quality limitations. Binance's official announcement identifies the address.
